svg.text: SYSTEMS RESEARCH · SEPT 2026 · SIDHI, MADHYA PRADESH
8 structures and 4 mental models that produce maternal
deaths — what sits below the events in Sidhi.
THE ICEBERG — WHAT YOU SEE → WHAT RUNS IT
STRUCTURES — 8 · THE SYSTEM DESIGN THAT PRODUCES THE DEATHS
75–85% specialist shortfall at CHCs, year after year. No
ob-gyn + anaesthetist on duty means no C-sections below
Hundreds of facilities carry the First Referral Unit tag but
can't do C-sections or transfusions. The referral chain has no
Lower facilities may only store whole blood. PPH and anaemia
need components — platelets, FFP, packed cells — not whole
PAID FOR THE EVENT, NOT THE OUTCOME
JSY rewards the delivery; JSSK's “free” package leaks into
out-of-pocket payments. Money follows the countable output.
AN AUDIT LOOP THAT NEVER CLOSES
MDSR mandates 24-hour notification and response, but reviews
end at form-filling and reporting invites blame. Lessons die
NHM funds stall Centre → state → district. Unspent balances
and delayed releases while facilities lack basics.
108 / Janani Express guarantee a vehicle — often no paramedic,
no oxygen. 13 of Sidhi's 53 died in transit.
IFA and Hb-testing break between procurement and the woman:
52.9% of MP's pregnant women are anaemic. Survivable bleeds
MENTAL MODELS — 4 · THE ASSUMPTIONS BAKED INTO THE DESIGN
The metric counts where women deliver, not what happens there.
89% institutional births; Sidhi MMR 211 vs 87 national.
The reflex to failure is paper — notices, committees, WhatsApp
directions — with no link to postings, budgets, consequences.
Most PPH/eclampsia deaths had no prior flags. The system
staffs for the average delivery, not the emergency.
The disciplining feedback loop — political voice, media,
litigation — is weakest where ST women live. Neglect is the
The system delivers scale better than outcomes — 89%
institutional births, MMR 211 in Sidhi vs 87 national.
